english.note: Use this when exquisite means demanding high standards or being particular about taste and quality.

examples.english: My mother has exquisite standards for ingredients and will not buy anything that is not fresh.
examples.traditional: 我阿媽對食材好講究，唔新鮮嘅一律唔買。
